Callout.Name: Narcotics Stash House
Callout.Message: Address believed to be used to hold narcotics.
Callout.Advisory: Foot traffic through the day, nobody there now.

Script.Line: Nobody is in there. Look through the window.
People come up here for the shop at the end. That is all the traffic.
I have not got a key. The landlord has the key.

Lines.Approach: People in and out all day and never in there longer than ten minutes.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
